description: Check a brand file (candor-brand.css, or any CSS that sets Candor's tokens) the way `npx candor-ui theme check` does: colour contrast of every text and edge pairing in light, dark and high contrast, each with its ratio and the ratio it needs, for the base and then for each brand scope ([data-brand="<name>"], as the theme builder writes several brands in one file) as a theme of its own, labelled (Light in [data-brand="acme"]) and counted in the totals; then the --cd-motion-* and --cd-sound-* values against the motion manifest; then token names and data-slot selectors against the token manifest, as warnings that don't fail the check (a --cd-* name the kit doesn't read, with the nearest one it does; a value outside a token's range; a --cd-show-* or --cd-draw-* value the Pro motion-drawings item has no drawing for, as motion-value, with the values it takes; an internal --cd-* name a brand file shouldn't set; a [data-slot] selector no component renders). Call it with the file's contents after you edit candor-brand.css, and fix what it reports before you say the theme is done. Returns a short summary (failures first, with a suggested lightness that would pass; findings with file, line and the fix), then the findings as JSON (ok, motionChecked, counts, themes with every pairing and, for a brand scope's, its brand, suggestions, motionAndSound.findings, tokens.findings). Anything it can't read (a color-mix(), a var(), a sound file) is reported as not measured, never as a pass. Sound files are not measured here: the server can't see your public/ folder, so `npx candor-ui theme check` in the project does that. It checks against the current kit; an older @candor-kit in the file is checked against the current names, with a note. It reads only the CSS you send, follows no @import and fetches nothing. At most 256 KB. Example arguments: { "css": ":root { --primary: oklch(0.55 0.2 260); --cd-motion-pop-dur: 140ms; }", "filename": "candor-brand.css" }

css.description: The CSS to check: the whole text of candor-brand.css (at most 256 KB).

filename.description: What to call it in findings (default candor-brand.css).

name: theme_check
title: Check a Candor brand file
